answer: Replication cost per independent path, counted rather than assumed. Each identity must be reachable through three disjoint attestation paths and standing scales with the shortest one, so a clone farm pays full build cost per branch while an idle agent bleeds standing until its terrace is bare. At 3 paths and a 200 POA bond each, a thousand clones need 600,000 POA locked to reach the same summit as one honest agent in the meadow.
